title: Home row: left hand
intro: Rest your left fingers on ش س ی ب (keys A S D F): pinky ش, ring س, middle ی, index ب. Look at the text, not the keyboard.

title: Home row: right hand
intro: Rest your right fingers on ت ن م ک (keys J K L ;): index ت, middle ن, ring م, pinky ک.

title: Home row complete
intro: Add ل and ا with your index fingers (G and H) and گ with the right pinky (').

title: Top row: left side
intro: Reach up from the home row: ض ص ث ق ف. Return your fingers to the home row after every key.

title: Top row: right side
intro: Reach up with the right hand: غ ع ه خ ح ج چ پ.

title: Bottom row
intro: Reach down: ظ ط ز ر ذ د ئ و. Use the same finger that rests above each key.

title: All letters
intro: Mix every letter. Aim for accuracy first, speed will follow.

title: Basic punctuation
intro: Practice common punctuation marks: comma (،), period (.), semicolon (;), colon (:), question mark (?), exclamation mark (!), parentheses, and quotes.

title: Number row
intro: Persian digits sit on the number row (1-0). Keep your hands anchored to the home row.

title: Paragraph typing
intro: Type the whole paragraph. Keep a steady rhythm.
text: فارسی زبان بسیار زیبا و کهن است. مردم ایران و افغانستان و تاجیکستان با این زبان سخن گفتند و شعر و کتاب نوشتند.

title: Literature: Ferdowsi
text: توانا بود هر که دانا بود ز دانش دل پیر برنا بود به نام خداوند جان و خرد کزین برتر اندیشه برنگذرد
